name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán Kovács's journey into the world of motorsport finance began unexpectedly. Originally on track to become a research mathematician, a chance encounter with a struggling racing team during his university years sparked a passion for combining his analytical skills with the high-octane environment of racing. He started as a volunteer, meticulously tracking expenses and identifying areas for cost savings. This dedication quickly led to a full-time role, and he's since honed his expertise in financial planning, budget management, and regulatory compliance within the motorsport industry.

At MP Motorsport Junior, Zoltán is known for his rigorous approach to financial control. He believes in proactive risk management and strives to provide the team with the financial stability needed to pursue their ambitious goals. His detail-oriented nature and unwavering commitment to accuracy make him a valuable asset. While approachable, Zoltán prefers to focus on the numbers, and is laser-focused on maintaining fiscal responsibility.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out abacus in his briefcase, claiming it helps him 'stay grounded'.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought, which can be unnerving.
Insists on calculating all expenses in Hungarian Forints first, then converting to Euros.
